methods.text:
Annotation of the golden sample: *T cells* first, then the `leiden` clusters.

Single-cell data were explored interactively in Cellucid (version 0.9.6). The dataset “History golden” (600 cells and 4 genes) was opened in full. The 7 steps applied are listed below, in order. 1 recorded step no longer applied after an earlier step was removed and is not included. The complete history, with every parameter, can be reopened from the accompanying Cellucid session file.

Before QC
The following 1 step was applied: (1) renamed NK cell to NK in cell_type.

QC
The following 2 steps were applied, in this order: (2) highlighted 40 cells as "Doublets" on page "QC"; (3) added the continuous column score. Steps 2–3 were taken by a Python notebook through the Cellucid viewer API.

After QC
The following 4 steps were applied, in this order: (4) ran Marker genes; (5) kept the gene set T cell markers (2 genes); (6) colored by gene CD3E; (7) merged B cell into T cell in cell_type. Steps 4–6 were taken by an AI assistant (Claude, claude-sonnet-4-6) at the user's request.

Annotation of the golden sample: *T cells* first, then the `leiden` clusters.

Single-cell data were explored interactively in Cellucid (version 0.9.6). The dataset “History golden” (600 cells and 4 genes) was opened in full. The 4 steps applied are listed below, in order. The complete history, with every parameter, can be reopened from the accompanying Cellucid session file.

Before QC
The following 1 step was applied: (1) renamed NK cell to NK in cell_type.

QC
The following 1 step was applied: (2) highlighted 40 cells as "Doublets" on page "QC". Step 2 was taken by a Python notebook through the Cellucid viewer API.

After QC
The following 2 steps were applied, in this order: (3) renamed leiden to cluster; (4) renamed 0 to Zero in leiden.

Annotation of the golden sample: *T cells* first, then the `leiden` clusters.

Single-cell data were explored interactively in Cellucid (version 0.9.6). The dataset “History golden” (600 cells and 4 genes) was opened in full. The 6 steps applied are listed below, in order. For step 6, only the state it reached was kept, not the operations that led to it. 3 further steps only changed the camera, the panel layout, colors or display settings and are not listed. The complete history, with every parameter, can be reopened from the accompanying Cellucid session file.

Before QC
The following 1 step was applied: (1) renamed NK cell to NK in cell_type.

QC
The following 2 steps were applied, in this order: (2) highlighted 40 cells as "Doublets" on page "QC"; (3) added the continuous column score. Steps 2–3 were taken by a Python notebook through the Cellucid viewer API.

After QC
The following 3 steps were applied, in this order: (4) ran Marker genes; (5) kept the gene set T cell markers (2 genes); (6) 2 steps merged into one (active field, camera). Steps 4–5 were taken by an AI assistant (Claude, claude-sonnet-4-6) at the user's request.

pseudocode.text:
# Cellucid 0.9.6 · History golden
# Tracker "Annotation", branch "Main": 8 steps
rename_category("cell_type", "NK cell", "NK")
# --- QC ---
highlight_cells(<40 cells>, label="Doublets", page="QC", color="#e41a1c")  # Python
push_column("score", kind="continuous")  # Python
# --- end of QC ---
run_analysis("markers")  # Claude
gene_set("T cell markers", ["CD3E", "NKG7"])  # Claude
# Bookmark: Markers saved
color_by(gene="CD3E")  # Claude
# No longer applies (There is no highlight "Gate" on page "QC"; its highlights are "Doublets".): set_highlight_enabled("Gate", False, page="QC")
merge_categories("cell_type", "B cell", into="T cell")

# Cellucid 0.9.6 · History golden
# Tracker "Annotation", branch "Scratch": 9 steps
rename_category("cell_type", "NK cell", "NK")
# --- QC ---
highlight_cells(<40 cells>, label="Doublets", page="QC", color="#e41a1c")  # Python
push_column("score", kind="continuous")  # Python
# --- end of QC ---
run_analysis("markers")  # Claude
gene_set("T cell markers", ["CD3E", "NKG7"])  # Claude
# Bookmark: Markers saved
set_camera("View 1", <camera>)
# Changes made with recording paused: Colors, Settings (values only)
# 2 steps merged into one: Active field, Camera (values only)
# Bookmark: Before tidying (on a step merged into this one)
set_camera("View 1", <camera>)

# Cellucid 0.9.6 · History golden
# Tracker "Annotation (replay)", branch "Main": 2 steps
rename_category("cell_type", "NK cell", "NK")  # Replay
highlight_cells(<40 cells>, label="Doublets", page="QC", color="#e41a1c")  # Replay
